description: One JSON report written by every hme measurement command. Raw numbers are for the record. The agent acts on verdict, corrections, context, next, and limits. No report is hardcoded to a video, a segment, or a frame count.

control_ceiling.note: Clean video vs its player screenshot.

context.meaning: A perfect clone scores about 0.96 here, so 0.79 is a real clone gap, not a measurement gap.

corrections.fix: Move the badge path 0.75 s later. It is still growing from 5 s to 7 s. Do not set it full size at 4 s.

limits: This measurement cannot see motion blur, grain, or z-order.
Frame 120 is one frame. Timing errors need the full trace.

verdict.detail: Mean SSIM 0.79 is below the bar.

context.description: The thresholds used, the control ceiling, and what the numbers mean.

control_ceiling.description: What a perfect clone scores here, from the control experiment. Null when no control exists yet.

meaning.description: One or two plain sentences saying what the numbers mean.

thresholds.description: The bar values this verdict was judged against.

corrections.description: Structured fixes in scene terms, directly applicable. Empty when there is nothing to fix.

at_s.description: Time in seconds where the error was measured.

fix.description: The fix in plain words, in scene terms.

kind.description: The kind of error: timing, position, size, colour, shape, text, or similar.

px.description: Measured pixel count of the element on our side.
Measured pixel count of the element on the real side.

dx.description: Real x minus our x, in pixels.

dy.description: Real y minus our y, in pixels.

source.description: Which command and frame produced this correction.

limits.description: What this measurement cannot see, so the agent does not over-trust a number.

next.description: The single most useful next command, as one command line.

numbers.description: The raw metrics, for the record. Keys vary by command.

verdict.description: PASS or FAIL, and which bar failed.

detail.description: One plain sentence saying what failed or passed.

failed_bar.description: The bar that failed, in plain words with its threshold. Null when status is PASS.

title: hme insight report
